LanguageData.Binguin_RodBaitJellyMood.label: insect jelly bait
LanguageData.Binguin_RodBaitJellyMood.description: The rod's bearer baits with insect jelly, and a sweet fragrance lingers about.
LanguageData.Binguin_RodBaitHumanKill.label: satisfaction of human meat bait
LanguageData.Binguin_RodBaitHumanKill.description: Baiting with human meat, the angler tastes a strange pleasure in the kill.
LanguageData.Binguin_StinkFishSmell.label: Reeking of stinkfish
LanguageData.Binguin_StinkFishSmell.description: Caked in the smell of stinkfish cans, and nothing will wash it off.
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.0.label: Sat through a dull concert
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.0.descrip: The performance was flat and forgettable; I left feeling a little empty.
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.1.label: Attended an ordinary concert
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.1.descrip: A middle-of-the-road show, neither good nor bad.
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.2.label: Attended a memorable concert
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.2.descrip: A great performance; several of the songs stayed with me.
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.3.label: Felt a real resonance at the concert
LanguageData.Binguin_AttendedConcert.stages.3.descrip: The songs felt like they were sung just for me. I was deeply moved.
LanguageData.Binguin_AteFish.label: ate delicious fish
LanguageData.Binguin_AteFish.description: Such delicious fish! It sets me fairly glowing!
